code.good: const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
code.note: 密码学安全随机源，长度不低于 128 位熵
code.note_en: A cryptographically secure source with at least 128 bits of entropy

sections.p_en: Use a cryptographically secure source: CSPRNG (getrandom, secrets, crypto.randomBytes, OsRng). Give tokens at least 128 bits of entropy. Generate keys with a key management service rather than assembling them by hand.

quiz.q: Math.random 为何不能生成令牌？
options: 不具密码学安全性，输出可被推算
quiz.explain: 普通 PRNG 由种子决定序列。
quiz.q_en: Why can't Math.random generate tokens?
options_en: It is not cryptographically secure; output is predictable
quiz.explain_en: A seeded PRNG lets observers predict subsequent values.

quiz.q: 会话令牌建议熵下限？
quiz.explain: 128 位是业界普遍接受的下限。
quiz.q_en: Recommended minimum entropy for session tokens?
quiz.explain_en: 128 bits is the widely accepted floor.

quiz.q: 密钥应如何产生？
options: 由密钥管理服务或 CSPRNG 生成
quiz.explain: 随机性必须由可信来源保证。
quiz.q_en: How should keys be produced?
options_en: Generated by a key management service or CSPRNG
quiz.explain_en: Key randomness must come from a trustworthy source.

title: 点击劫持
title_en: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers
summary: 攻击者用透明 iframe 覆盖在诱导页面上，让用户在不知情的情况下点到真实站点的按钮。
summary_en: Transparent iframes trick users into clicking real site controls.

sections.p: 浏览器允许页面通过 iframe 嵌入其他站点。攻击者把目标站点嵌进来并设为全透明，覆盖在一个有诱导文案的页面上。用户以为点的是「领取奖励」，实际点的是目标站点的「确认转账」按钮。
sections.p_en: Browsers allow pages to embed other sites in iframes. An attacker embeds the target fully transparent, overlaying a decoy page. Users think they are clicking claim reward but actually click confirm transfer on the target site.

sections.p: 响应头缺少 X-Frame-Options 或 CSP frame-ancestors；认为只有支付页面需要防护；老系统未统一配置安全头。
sections.p_en: Responses lack X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors; teams assume only payment pages need protection; legacy systems never applied security headers.

sections.p: 检查响应头是否含 X-Frame-Options 或 CSP 的 frame-ancestors 指令；用简单 HTML 尝试嵌入目标页面观察是否被拒绝。
sections.p_en: Check whether responses include X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors; try embedding the target with a minimal HTML page and see whether it is refused.

sections.p: 全站下发 CSP frame-ancestors 'none' 或 'self'。高危操作增加二次确认。JS 侧作为补充可用 frame-busting，但不能作为唯一防线。

code.title: 缺安全头
code.good:
Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'
X-Frame-Options: DENY
code.note: 两条头同时下发，兼容老浏览器
code.note_en: Send both headers for older browser compatibility

sections.p_en: Send CSP frame-ancestors 'none' or 'self' site-wide. Add confirmation for high-risk actions. Frame-busting JavaScript is only a supplement, never the sole defense.

quiz.q: 点击劫持的技术基础是？
options: 透明 iframe 覆盖在诱导页面上
quiz.explain: 用户以为点的是诱饵，实际点到被嵌入的真实页面控件。
quiz.q_en: Technical basis of clickjacking?
options_en: Transparent iframes stacked under a decoy page
quiz.explain_en: Users think they click the decoy but hit real controls underneath.

quiz.q: 防御点击劫持最有效的响应头是？
quiz.explain: frame-ancestors 直接限制谁能嵌入本页。
quiz.q_en: Most effective response header against clickjacking?
quiz.explain_en: frame-ancestors restricts who may embed the page.

quiz.q: X-Frame-Options 与 CSP 的关系是？
options: CSP 更新更灵活，两者同时下发兼容老浏览器
quiz.explain: 现代浏览器优先 CSP，老浏览器回退到 X-Frame-Options。
quiz.q_en: Relationship between X-Frame-Options and CSP?
options_en: CSP is more flexible; send both for older browsers
quiz.explain_en: Modern browsers prefer CSP; older ones fall back to X-Frame-Options.

title: 正则表达式拒绝服务 ReDoS
summary: 存在灾难性回溯的正则被输入触发后，CPU 占用飙升，单次请求即可拖垮服务。
summary_en: Catastrophic backtracking in regex stalls the CPU.

sections.p: NFA 正则引擎在匹配失败时会尝试所有可能的分支组合。形如 (a+)+$ 的模式，面对 aaaa...a! 这样的输入，回溯次数随长度指数增长。一个几十字节的输入就能让单核跑满数分钟。
sections.p_en: NFA regex engines try every possible branch combination when a match fails. A pattern like (a+)+$ against aaaa...a! causes backtracking that grows exponentially with length. A few dozen bytes of input can saturate one CPU core for minutes.

sections.p: 为了匹配宽松格式而写出嵌套量词；在服务端用正则解析用户提交的复杂文本；第三方校验库内部有脆弱正则；缺少输入长度限制与执行超时。
sections.p_en: Nested quantifiers written to match loose formats; server-side regex parsing complex user-submitted text; vulnerable regex inside third-party validation libraries; missing input length limits and execution timeouts.

sections.p: 用 ReDoS 检测工具静态扫描正则；构造形如 aaaa...X 的失败输入测量执行时间随长度的变化；观察 CPU 在特定请求下是否飙升。
sections.p_en: Static scan regexes with ReDoS detection tools; craft failing inputs like aaaa...X and measure execution time growth with length; watch for CPU spikes on specific requests.

sections.p: 改写正则消除嵌套量词与重叠可选分支。使用 RE2、Rust regex 这类保证线性时间的引擎。对输入长度设上限。为解析操作设置执行超时并放入可中断的执行上下文。

code.title: 脆弱正则
code.good: const re = /^a+$/;
code.note: 去掉嵌套量词，回溯次数从指数级降到线性
code.note_en: Removing nested quantifiers takes backtracking from exponential to linear

sections.p_en: Rewrite regexes to remove nested quantifiers and overlapping alternatives. Use engines that guarantee linear time, such as RE2 or Rust regex. Cap input length. Set execution timeouts and run parsing in an interruptible context.

quiz.q: ReDoS 的本质是？
options: 正则引擎灾难性回溯导致 CPU 被占满
quiz.explain: 嵌套量词让失败匹配的回溯次数随输入长度指数增长。
quiz.q_en: Essence of ReDoS?
quiz.explain_en: Nested quantifiers make backtracking grow exponentially.

quiz.q: 下面哪个正则更可能引发 ReDoS？
quiz.explain: 嵌套量词在失败时会尝试大量组合。
quiz.q_en: Which regex is more likely to cause ReDoS?
quiz.explain_en: Nested quantifiers try huge numbers of combinations on failure.

quiz.q: 根治 ReDoS 的方向是？
options: 消除嵌套量词，或改用线性时间引擎（如 RE2）
quiz.explain: 从算法复杂度上根治，而不是靠限制输入兜底。
quiz.q_en: Direction for a real fix?
options_en: Remove nested quantifiers or use a linear-time engine like RE2
quiz.explain_en: Fix the algorithmic complexity, not just the input size.

title: 开放重定向
summary: 跳转参数未校验目标域名，攻击者可借助可信域名的链接把用户导向钓鱼站。
summary_en: Unvalidated redirect targets send users to attacker sites.

sections.p: 登录后跳转、短链服务、SSO 回调等场景会有 ?next= 之类参数。若不校验目标，攻击者构造 https://trusted.com/login?next=https://evil.com，链接前半段是可信域名，用户难以分辨，点击后落到钓鱼页。
sections.p_en: Login redirects, short link services, and SSO callbacks carry parameters like ?next=. Without validating the target, an attacker builds https://trusted.com/login?next=https://evil.com. The first half is a trusted domain, users cannot tell, and they land on a phishing page.

sections.p: 直接使用用户提供的值做跳转；只校验以 http 开头；黑名单校验域名，被 //evil.com、https://trusted.com@evil.com、子域名混淆绕过。
sections.p_en: Using the user-supplied value directly for the redirect; validating only that it starts with http; domain blacklists bypassed with //evil.com, https://trusted.com@evil.com, or subdomain confusion.

sections.p: 在跳转参数填 https://evil.com、//evil.com、/\evil.com、https://trusted.com.evil.com 观察是否发生跳转；检查 Location 响应头。
sections.p_en: Fill redirect parameters with https://evil.com, //evil.com, /\evil.com, and https://trusted.com.evil.com and observe whether a redirect happens; inspect the Location header.

sections.p: 使用相对路径或白名单映射（传 key 由服务端查表得出目标 URL）。必须接受绝对 URL 时，解析后校验协议为 https 且域名在白名单内，并做规范化处理防止绕过。

code.title: 直接用 next 参数
code.good:
ALLOWED = {"/home": "/home", "/orders": "/orders"}
return redirect(ALLOWED.get(request.args.get("next"), "/home"))
code.note: 只接受预定义 key，目标地址由服务端给出
code.note_en: Accept only predefined keys; the server supplies the destination

sections.p_en: Use relative paths or whitelist mapping (pass a key and let the server resolve the target URL). When absolute URLs must be accepted, parse and verify the scheme is https and the domain is whitelisted, with normalization to prevent bypasses.

quiz.q: 开放重定向为什么常被用于钓鱼？
options: 因为链接前半段是可信域名，用户难以分辨
quiz.explain: 攻击者把恶意地址藏在可信域名的参数里。
quiz.q_en: Why is open redirect popular for phishing?
options_en: The first half of the link is a trusted domain, hard to spot
quiz.explain_en: Attackers hide malicious targets inside trusted-domain parameters.

quiz.q: 防御开放重定向推荐的做法是？
options: 使用白名单映射：传 key 由服务端查表给出目标
quiz.explain: 黑名单会被域名混淆、@ 符号等手法绕过。
quiz.q_en: Recommended defense for open redirect?
options_en: Whitelist mapping: pass a key and let the server resolve the target
quiz.explain_en: Blacklists lose to domain confusion and @ tricks.

quiz.q: 下面哪个值最可能绕过简单的"以 http 开头"校验？
quiz.explain: 协议相对地址会跳到 evil.com，且不以 http 开头。
quiz.q_en: Which value most likely bypasses a naive starts-with-http check?
quiz.explain_en: A protocol-relative URL navigates to evil.com without starting with http.
